시편-148-1.title: 시편 148장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-148-1.exegesis: 19-20. This mighty ruler and benefactor of heaven and earth is such especially to His chosen people, to whom alone ( De 4:32-34 ) He has made known His will, while others have been left in darkness. Therefore unite in the great hallelujah.
시편-148-1.theologicalNote: 19-20. This mighty ruler and benefactor of heaven and earth is such especially to His chosen people, to whom alone ( De 4:32-34 ) He has made known His will, while others have been left in darkness. Therefore unite in the great hallelujah.

시편-148-2.title: 시편 148장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-148-2.exegesis: PSALM 148 Psa 148:1-14 . The scope of this Psalm is the same as that of the preceding. 1. heavens [and] heights-- are synonymous.
시편-148-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 148 Psa 148:1-14 . The scope of this Psalm is the same as that of the preceding. 1. heavens [and] heights-- are synonymous.

시편-148-5.title: 시편 148장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-148-5.exegesis: 4. heavens of heavens-- the very highest. waters-- clouds, resting above the visible heavens (compare Ge 1:7 ).
시편-148-5.theologicalNote: 4. heavens of heavens-- the very highest. waters-- clouds, resting above the visible heavens (compare Ge 1:7 ).

시편-148-6.title: 시편 148장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-148-6.exegesis: 5. praise the name-- as representing His perfections. he commanded-- "He" is emphatic, ascribing creation to God alone.
시편-148-6.theologicalNote: 5. praise the name-- as representing His perfections. he commanded-- "He" is emphatic, ascribing creation to God alone.

시편-148-7.title: 시편 148장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-148-7.exegesis: 6. The perpetuity of the frame of nature is, of course, subject to Him who formed it. a decree ... pass-- His ordinances respecting them shall not change ( Jr 36:31 ), or perish ( Job 34:20 ; Psa 37:36 ).
시편-148-7.theologicalNote: 6. The perpetuity of the frame of nature is, of course, subject to Him who formed it. a decree ... pass-- His ordinances respecting them shall not change ( Jr 36:31 ), or perish ( Job 34:20 ; Psa 37:36 ).

시편-148-8.title: 시편 148장 8절 역사문법적 주해
시편-148-8.exegesis: 7-10. The call on the earth, as opposed to heaven, includes seas or depths, whose inhabitants the dragon, as one of the largest (on leviathan, see on Psa 104:26 ), is selected to represent. The most destructive and ungovernable agents of inanimate nature are introduced.

시편-148-12.title: 시편 148장 12절 역사문법적 주해
시편-148-12.exegesis: 11-12. Next all rational beings, from the highest in rank to little children. princes-- or, military leaders.

시편-148-14.title: 시편 148장 14절 역사문법적 주해
시편-148-14.exegesis: 13. Let them-- all mentioned. excellent-- or, exalted ( Is 12:4 ). his glory-- majesty ( Psa 45:3 ). above the earth and heaven-- Their united splendors fail to match His.
